LESSON: TYPES OF BUSINESS OWNERSHIP

Grade: Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Business and its Environment
Topic 2.2: Types of Business Ownership
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Types of Business Ownership, part of Business and its Environment in Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies formed and managed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  discuss and present on the meaning of sole, proprietorship, partnership and cooperative society,  brainstorm and present on the formation and management of sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies,  use digital devices or print media to search for information on sources of finance for sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies,  debate on the advantages and disadvantages of a sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  discuss and present on the meaning of sole, proprietorship, partnership and cooperative society,  brainstorm and present on the formation and management of sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies,  use digital devices or print media to search for information on sources of finance for sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies,  debate on the advantages and disadvantages of a sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Types of Business Ownership together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication and Collaboration: The learner acquires reading, writing, listening, speaking and teamwork skills when

discussing, brainstorming and presenting on the meaning, formation and management of sole proprietorship, partnerships

and cooperative societies.

 Learning to Learn: The learner organises own learning when using digital devices or print media to search for sources of

finance for sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies in Kenya.

 Self-efficacy: The learner develops the skill of effective communication when debating on the advantages and disadvantages

of a sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies in Kenya.

Values:
 Respect: The learner appreciates diverse opinions when discussing and presenting on the meaning of sole proprietorship,

partnership and cooperative society.

 Love: The learner respects others when sharing digital devices or print media to search for information.

 Responsibility: The learner shows accountability when using digital devices or print media to search for information on

sources of finance for sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Financial literacy: The learners’ financial skills are enhanced when using digital devices or print media to search for

sources of finance for sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies.

 Internet safety and Security: Responsible online behaviour is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to analyse and

present case studies on the sole proprietorship, partnerships and cooperative societies.
